text.en: It always seems impossible until it is done.
text.zh-cn: 在事情完成之前，它看起来总是遥不可及。
text.fr: Cela paraît toujours impossible, jusqu'à ce que ce soit fait.

caption.en:
One sheet at a time, the corner filled up.

en: I waited until I was ready.

moral.en: Impossible is only the name things carry until they're done.
moral.ko: 불가능은 끝나기 전까지 붙어 있던 이름이었다.
